summary: Monitor an accepted rollup exchange without escalating it.

steps.title: Check quality assessment
steps.instruction: Read the quality assessment and confirm the confidence level, flags, uncertainty summary, and recommended use.
steps.expected_output: Quality caveats are understood before downstream use.

steps.title: Check reconciliation state
steps.instruction: Confirm whether the related reconciliation record leaves the subject active, superseded, rejected, corrected, or unresolved.
steps.expected_output: Downstream users understand the current result state.

steps.title: Check exchange receipt
steps.instruction: Confirm the exchange receipt state and whether the bundle was accepted, rejected, or still needs review.

steps.title: Record action update if needed
steps.instruction: If monitoring changes state, update or add an action record rather than editing evidence records.
steps.expected_output: Operational state is kept separate from evidence.

stop_conditions: required referenced records cannot be found
